decisions.protected_subject: Digest action, resource, environment, artifact, specification, policy revision, risk, and incident; any material change requires a new decision.
decisions.trusted_identity_and_authority_sources: Authenticate workforce sessions and resolve current grants, protected resources, policy, and incidents from independently administered stores.
decisions.separation_of_duties: Requester and implementation author cannot approve; consequential production requires distinct release and AI-governance principals.
decisions.delegation_attenuation: Child role equals parent role; action, resource, environment, risk, time, and redelegation rights are subsets of a current delegable parent; every use rechecks current containment, and durable parent narrowing or revocation invalidates the child after restart.
decisions.concurrent_single_use_enforcement: Validate and conditionally consume every receipt, transition the operation, mutate and verify the local protected resource, and register one success in a serializing transaction; use remote idempotency and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME reconciliation outside the local boundary.
decisions.emergency_containment_and_recovery: Require an active affected incident and scoped responder for short-lived reversible containment; authorize recovery separately and require retrospective review.

non_authority: This reference is a teaching comparison, not an enterprise approval.
